title: An empty chair at the all-night laundromat never stays empty
description:
My washer broke in the first freeze, so I took my wash to the all-night laundromat and sat at the folding table behind a row of orange chairs. The first night I came in soaked, a dryer I never used buzzed, and inside was a green wool coat in my size.

The second night, something was sitting in the chairs with its back to me. It was looking at me anyway. The next night, it was one chair nearer.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have worn a coat you found in a dryer you never used?
